Subject: Deployment mode qualification — post-call recap & next steps

Hi Emily,

Thanks again for taking the call earlier — really enjoyed learning more about BrightCare's roadmap. Quick recap and suggested next steps so we can align on the right deployment mode (Hosted API vs Dedicated vs Private VPC/on-prem):

Summary of BrightCare requirements (from call):
- Must be HIPAA-compliant; looking to sign a BAA.
- Need SOC 2 Type II evidence for vendor review; audits on an annual cadence.
- Data residency: US-only (primary and backups).
- Primary preference: Private VPC or on-prem (for maximum isolation), but open to Dedicated capacity if BAA/SOC2 evidence and network controls meet procurement requirements.
- Audit access: they may request architecture diagrams and evidence of controls for encryption, key management, and logging.

What I can provide this week:
- Redwood SOC 2 Type II report (redacted) and our BAA template.
- High-level deployment architecture diagram for Private VPC and Dedicated variants.
- Answers to specific audit checklist items you flagged during the call (KMS/HSM, logging/retention, incident response).

Recommended next steps:
1) I’ll send SOC2 and the BAA template as attachments — please share with procurement/security.
2) Can we get your vendor security questionnaire (or a list of the top-10 must-have controls) so Rishi can map controls to our architecture?
3) Schedule a short follow-up (30 min) next week to review where Dedicated vs Private VPC would land on timelines and price.

Proposed times: Tue 7/21 10:00–10:30am PT or Wed 7/22 9:00–9:30am PT. Let me know what works and I’ll send a calendar invite.

Attachments: Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_2026.pdf (redacted), Redwood_BAA_template.docx, deployment_arch_diagram.png

Thanks,

Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive

- Control mappings for encryption, access control, logging, incident response (I’ll deliver a spreadsheet mapping your questionnaire to SOC2 sections).
- Architecture diagram showing network isolation, NAT, private endpoints, and VPC peering options (attached).

- Dedicated capacity (hosted in our managed clouds): can be set to use your cloud KMS; however, on truly on-prem air-gapped installations we recommend the Private on-prem deploy.
